```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-kv-micro
#| fig-cap: "Single insert and get latency — all four variants"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

ops = ['Insert', 'Get']
x = np.arange(len(ops))
w = 0.18

# Data: ns/op
kv2  = [18.69, 22.06]
kvn  = [18.88, 21.73]
dyn  = [49.44, 42.40]
hm   = [44.87, 23.79]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

ax.bar(x - 1.5*w, kv2, w, label='CoordKV2', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
ax.bar(x - 0.5*w, kvn, w, label='CoordKVN<2>', color='white', edgecolor='gray', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
ax.bar(x + 0.5*w, dyn, w, label='DynCoordKV', color='white', edgecolor='gray', linewidth=0.8, hatch='oo')
ax.bar(x + 1.5*w, hm,  w, label='HashMap', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(ops, fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Latency (ns)', fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc='upper left')
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.3)

# Value labels
for xi, (a, b, c, d) in enumerate(zip(kv2, kvn, dyn, hm)):
    ax.text(xi - 1.5*w, a + 1.5, f'{a}', fontsize=7, ha='center')
    ax.text(xi - 0.5*w, b + 1.5, f'{b}', fontsize=7, ha='center')
    ax.text(xi + 0.5*w, c + 1.5, f'{c}', fontsize=7, ha='center')
    ax.text(xi + 1.5*w, d + 1.5, f'{d}', fontsize=7, ha='center')

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
